messages:
incidents-bot: Pager triggered — billing.metering.counts prod-us-east: token_agg_variance = 38% over 5m, alert threshold 25% — paging oncall:billing (link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1767894321)
ashok: acked, looking
kira: I'm on call for billing — jumping in. any immediate customer-facing alerts? :eyes:
maria: support-bot just flagged 6 customer overage emails queued in the last 10m. see /support/overage-queue
simon: logs look noisy; multiple emitter retries from proxy-2 (10.2.4.8). suspect duplicate emission from edge retry loop.
eli: adding context — we rolled a proxy-binary patch 12h ago with new retry backoff; could be related.
billing-eng: can we suppress outgoing overage notifications while we triage? want to avoid false billing emails.
kira: yes — we're going to flip suppression. ashok, can you run the suppression playbook?
ashok: running: 
```
./ops/suppress-overage-notifications --scope=prod-us-east --reason=\"metering variance\"
```
ashok: cmd success, suppression=on, notifications will queue but not send :white_check_mark:
simon: starting a quick dedupe check on ingestion stream. tailing emitter logs:
```
grep \"emit_success\" /var/log/emitter/proxy-2.log | tail -n 50
\"\"\"
# repeated token_ids in windows of ~30s
\"\"\"
```
billing-eng: if duplicates confirmed, we should enable short-term emitter-idempotency filter at the aggregation layer to drop exact token_id repeats.
eli: I can push a hotfix config to aggregator to ignore consecutive duplicates for 60s. rolling now.
eli: config applied to agg-pool-1 (prod-us-east) — filter_window=60s :rocket:
kira: good. Maria, what's the customer impact surface if we leave suppression on for 30m?
maria: customers won't get billing overage email but usage will still be metered; we'll surface a banner for affected customers via support channels. support-bot queued a status update draft.
support-bot: Draft: \"We've detected anomalous billing reports in us-east. We're suppressing overage notifications while we investigate. You may see delayed usage reports; your actual usage is not being billed twice. Updates every 15m.\" Would you like to post?
maria: post it after we confirm dedupe count update.
ashok: dedupe job running — initial result: ~14% of recent tokens appear duplicated at aggregation boundary. variance aligns with that.
simon: Agree — root cause likely emitter retry amplification after proxy patch. Reverting the retry change for proxy-2 should reduce duplicates. planning revert now.
eli: prepping rollback for proxy-2 binary to previous stable commit sha: a1b2c3d
eli: rollback started on proxy-2, monitoring.
ashok: aggregation counts recalculated with dedupe filter — variance now 6% in last 2m.
kira: nice. can we start a controlled replay to compute corrected token totals for last 30m for billing reconciliation?
billing-eng: yes, run replay on archival stream with dedupe policy applied, write corrected delta to billing-shadow for recon.
ashok: launching replay job: job id r-176789-replay. estimated 8m.
simon: proxy-2 rollback completed, emitter error-rate back to baseline.
eli: confirming: no more repeated token_id patterns in the tail logs.
maria: posted status update to status.redwood.io and help center. link: https://status.redwood.io/incidents/1767894321
support-bot: Customer-facing post sent. :loudspeaker:
billing-eng: replay job finished. corrected delta: -12.3k tokens across 6 customers showing temporary overcounts. writing patch to billing-shadow.
ashok: patch applied to billing-shadow. scheduling reconciliation job to flow corrected totals into billing pipeline with corrections flag and note.
billing-eng: triage summary: root cause — increased emitter retries from proxy-2 after recent retry-backoff change caused duplicate token emission at ingestion boundary. mitigation steps: 1) suppress overage notifications, 2) enable short-term dedupe window at aggregator, 3) rollback proxy-2 retry change, 4) replay and shadow-correct token totals, 5) post customer status.  Estimated customer impact: transient delayed reports, 6 customers with brief overage flags, no billable double-charges after shadow reconciliation.
kira: moving to monitoring phase. will keep suppression for 30m then re-evaluate. assigning follow-ups to billing-eng for reconciliations and to eng-runtime for a global audit of retry-change rollout safety.
eli: will open PR for safe rollout checklist and add smoke tests for emitter-idempotency.
ashok: final check: current token variance at 2% over 10m — closing pager but keeping thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
incidents-bot: Pager resolved — incident automatically marked resolved (duration 00:48:59). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1767894321/summary
maria: filing postmortem with timeline and customer communication artifacts.
support-bot: Reminder: follow-up checklist created and assigned to support, billing-eng, eng-runtime, and infra.
